title: Spatially resolved transcriptomics in human brain metastases identifies macrophage-tumor interactions associated with survival.
snippet: Despite advances in treatment approaches, the mean survival for patients with brain metastases remains poor. The incidence of brain metastases continues to rise, and there remains a need to identify novel therapeutics targeting mechanisms critical for brain metastasis.
